facts.fact: The INS Annuaire statistique 2024 (cover dated October 2025; figures cover 2016-2024; as_of is its publication date) publishes tables sourced to ministry statistics bureaux (BSD) for education, health, justice and security, to the CNSS social security fund, and to transport bodies including the customs directorate.

The INS published the Annuaire statistique 2024 in October 2025, compiled from data collected by forms filled in by sector ministries' structures and from their national databases; as_of is the publication date, not the 2016-2024 period of the figures.
